description: A tool call is refused because the bridge could not ask the operator for approval, Detail carries the cause
other: herrscher: approval could not be asked, so this tool call is refused: {{.Detail}}

description: A tool call is refused because a request with the same ID is already waiting for the operator
other: a request with the same ID is already waiting for the operator

description: A tool call is refused because the operator did not answer within the hook wait, Wait carries the duration
Notice in the skill menu when a token budget hid skills, Count carries how many were hidden, Dirs the directories that hold every skill
other: Skills hidden from this list: {{.Count}}. Each skill is a folder with a SKILL.md file, and the hidden ones sit in these directories: {{.Dirs}}.

description: Notice after a skill body cut by the expansions token budget, Name is the skill and Path the file to read in full
other: The {{.Name}} skill is cut here to fit the skill budget. To read it in full, open {{.Path}}.

description: Error when the skills-budget file of an agent cannot be read or parsed, Agent is the agent and Detail the cause
other: The skills budget of agent {{.Agent}} cannot be read ({{.Detail}}). Fix or remove its skills-budget file.

description: Error when the menuTokens of the skills budget is below the fixed cost of the menu, Menu is the budget and Floor the least it needs
other: The skills menu budget ({{.Menu}} tokens) is below the {{.Floor}} tokens the menu needs even with no skill listed. Raise menuTokens in the agent's skills-budget file.
